phases.name: Discovery, Product Definition and Compliance Blueprint
phases.deliverables: Athlete management, coach management, teams, daily check-ins, core dashboard, basic recommendations.
phases.business_value: First usable platform for clubs and pilot athletes.
phases.acceptance_criteria: Athletes can check in daily; coaches can review basic readiness and training completion.

phases.name: Athlete OS Foundation
phases.deliverables: Oura, Whoop, Garmin, Polar, Apple Health, Google Health Connect and Fitbit connector framework.
phases.business_value: Automatic recovery and activity signals reduce manual entry.
phases.acceptance_criteria: Device data is ingested, normalised, visible and used in recovery/readiness scores.

phases.name: Wearable Ecosystem
phases.deliverables: Operational database, object storage, data warehouse design, Digital Twin schema, historical trend layer.
phases.acceptance_criteria: Each athlete has a Digital Twin record updated from daily and device data.

phases.name: Cloud Data Platform and Digital Twin Foundation
phases.deliverables: Processing queue, worker nodes, job orchestration, monitoring, first local model deployment.
phases.business_value: Privacy-first AI differentiator and predictable processing costs.
phases.acceptance_criteria: Nightly jobs run locally and write results back to the cloud platform.

phases.name: Local AI Cluster
phases.deliverables: Readiness Engine, Recovery Engine, Development Engine, Recommendation Engine, explainability layer.
phases.acceptance_criteria: Coaches receive explainable recommendations with confidence levels.

phases.name: AI Intelligence Layer
phases.deliverables: Photo analysis, video upload, frame extraction, pose detection, sprint/running/jump/kicking analysis MVP.
phases.business_value: Major differentiator and visible AI value.
phases.acceptance_criteria: Uploaded videos are analysed overnight and produce movement observations.

phases.name: Athlete Vision
phases.deliverables: GPS, timing gates, BlazePod, FITLIGHT, force plate connector patterns and normalised metrics.
phases.business_value: Supports premium clubs and academies with existing performance equipment.
phases.acceptance_criteria: Device data is imported, normalised and available in the Digital Twin.

phases.name: Performance Lab
phases.deliverables: Athlete dashboard, coach dashboard, team dashboard, messaging, calendar, reporting, athlete portal.
phases.business_value: Makes the system operational for everyday club use.
phases.acceptance_criteria: Different roles receive relevant dashboards and can communicate within permission boundaries.

phases.name: Performance Dashboards, Mobile Portal and Communication
phases.deliverables: Risk assessment, load monitoring, movement screening, recovery monitoring, prevention plan workflow.
phases.business_value: High-value module for clubs, parents and performance departments.
phases.acceptance_criteria: At-risk athletes are flagged with explainable factors and human review workflows.

phases.name: Injury Prevention Hub
phases.deliverables: Open API, exports, role model hardening, multilingual readiness, multi-country deployment controls.
phases.acceptance_criteria: Data exports, APIs and international settings work under admin control.

phases.name: Integrations, Ecosystem and Internationalisation
phases.deliverables: Security review, DPIA completion support, monitoring, backups, support model, onboarding playbooks.
phases.acceptance_criteria: Pilot customer can operate the system safely with support and monitoring.

phases.name: Go-Live, Security Hardening and Operational Support
